name: blender
instruction: Blender is a 3D modeling, animation, and rendering application. LAUNCH: Use the 'launch' action with target 'blender'. SPLASH SCREEN: When Blender opens, you will see a splash screen with 'New File' options (General, 2D Animation, Sculpting, VFX, Video Editing) on the left and 'Recent Files' on the right. To open a recent file like 'Flipper.Blend', use click_text: {"type": "click_text", "text": "Flipper.Blend"}. To open a new General project, use: {"type": "click_text", "text": "General"}. To dismiss the splash, click anywhere outside it in the 3D viewport. MAIN AREAS: 3D Viewport (center), Properties (right), Outliner (top-right), Timeline (bottom). KEY SHORTCUTS: Tab=Edit/Object mode toggle, Shift+A=Add menu, G=Grab/Move, R=Rotate, S=Scale, X=Delete, Ctrl+Z=Undo, Numpad0=Camera view, F12=Render. NAVIGATION: Middle-mouse=Orbit, Scroll=Zoom, Shift+Middle=Pan. MENUS: Always use click_text for menu items. Example: To open File menu, use {"type": "click_text", "text": "File"}, then {"type": "click_text", "text": "Open"}. CRITICAL: NEVER guess pixel coordinates for Blender UI elements. ALWAYS use click_text for buttons, menus, panel headers, file names, and any text you can read on screen.
